name: EPIC 205012644
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 11.9 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205012644 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.907199 (16th-84th percentiles 11.814273-12.008849), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,674 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 0.84 solar masses and 11.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,394 K at its surface.
